customManagers.description: Keep the app version in lockstep with the Vaultwarden image tag

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: one grouped PR, merged automatically once CI passes
Vaultwarden: Dockerfile tag + digest and config.yaml version in one PR
prBodyNotes: Before merging: add a `## <new version>` section to `vaultwarden/CHANGELOG.md` (the version check fails until you do), and read the Vaultwarden release notes for config changes. See RELEASING.md.

packageRules.description: Vaultwarden in the Dockerfile: stay on the -alpine variant
Tailscale, cloudflared and jq: one grouped PR; needs a packaging revision
prBodyNotes: Before merging: bump `version` in `vaultwarden/config.yaml` to the next packaging revision (the version check names it) and add a CHANGELOG entry. See RELEASING.md.
